cohort: 100 pregnant women diagnosed with PPROM and admitted to the labour and delivery room at Women Health Hospital, Assiut University.
finding: The prevalence of PPROM was 1.85%, and statistically significant risk factors included maternal age, residence, BMI, occupational level, gravidity, parity, gestational age, number of abortions, previous history of PROM, and previous mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Previous mode of delivery was identified as a statistically significant risk factor for the occurrence of PPROM.
